summary: Ambitious Human Resources Generalist with 35+ years of experience leading HR strategy, talent acquisition, employee relations, benefits administration, and organizational development for real estate, healthcare/IT, and legal firms.
certifications: Notary Public for the State of Maryland

experience.title: Director of HR
responsibilities: Directly report to CEO and VP of a 65‑year‑old real estate property management company.
Oversee day‑to‑day operations of HR, administration, and technology with supervision of two staff members.
Create employee handbook and design comprehensive annual employee survey.
Research, analyze, and select annual company health benefits.
Implement and train employees on new payroll system.
Design and establish training program for maintenance employees.
Conduct full‑cycle recruitment and onboarding program.
Develop wellness program and preventative health initiatives to reduce healthcare premiums.
Create annual employee bonus program aligned with company goals.
Manage office construction build‑out and office move, including contractor selection, vendor negotiation, and contract management.

experience.title: Vice President and Director of Human Resources and Administration
responsibilities: Report directly to Founder/CEO of a fast‑growing healthcare/IT startup.
Grow company from 45 to 215 employees across 32 states and Puerto Rico.
Serve as sole HR practitioner until 2011, responsible for all HR and administration functions.
Design, develop, and implement company‑wide initiatives as senior leadership team member.
Demonstrate talent acquisition and management, coaching, and mentoring.
Create and deploy monthly two‑day onboarding program, reducing turnover from 28% to under 10%.
Develop and administer employee and cultural surveys, delivering workforce analytics to senior management.
Lead selection, implementation, and training of custom payroll and leave tracking system and performance management software.
Create corporate university training program for account managers.
Manage office space planning, construction build‑out, vendor contracts, and equipment leases.

experience.title: Business Manager
responsibilities: Oversee office operations for a 21‑person law firm, including HR, finance, administration, and IT.
Handle employee relations, compensation, benefits administration, payroll processing, and recruitment.
Produce annual and monthly financial reports, statements, and client invoices.
Manage accounts receivable/payable, petty cash, and bank reconciliations.
Negotiate vendor contracts, office leases, and equipment purchases.
Project manage transition from Novell to Windows platform and new telephone system.
Create company/employee handbook and train staff.

experience.title: Vice President/Business Manager
responsibilities: Administer and grow office talent from 18 to over 120 employees, driving income growth from $1.3M to $37M.
Supervise 14 HR, finance, IT, and administration professionals.
Lead office relocation, market survey, consultant selection, and $1.9M build‑out of 44,000 sq. ft.
Develop and implement employee handbook, orientation program, and quality‑of‑life welfare program.
Create reward and recognition program to improve morale and reduce turnover.
Forecast annual and quarterly budgets, prepare financial statements, and present plans to corporate headquarters.
Negotiate client, vendor, and government contracts.
